evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep immediately jumped into "Do you have a few moments to go over that?" without the time-boxed framing (10-15 min) or promise of a dependable quote.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asked "And then do you have any questions or concerns you would like answered on this call in regards to the move?" — but only after already confirming contact info and starting logistics probing. Customer then raised concerns about hourly rate per person and mattress wrapping.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised multiple concerns (hourly rate clarity, mattress/cabinet wrapping, TV mounting/storage, move duration vs. apartment size). Rep followed up on each: 'Yes, so it's 204 for two movers...' / 'Yeah, absolutely' + TV bag explanation / acknowledged the 2.5hr minimum concern. Each concern received substantive follow-up.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No summary reflection. Rep acknowledged concerns and answered them individually but never reflected back 'So what I'm hearing is...' or confirmed all concerns were covered.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment), floor/stories (4th floor origin, 5th floor destination), square footage (670 sqft → 750 sqft), walking distance (50 feet to elevator), elevator access/reservability, box count estimate (15-25 boxes), parking. All seven logistics items covered.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Rep asked: 'to book a box move for the size is about fifteen to 25 boxes. Do you feel like you would fall within that range?' Customer confirmed yes.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: No packing services offer made. Only wrapping/protective measures discussed (mattress wrapping, TV bagging).
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gave the rate ($204/two movers, $126/box truck) and mentioned the 2.5-hour minimum, but did not give a typical range for a move this size (670-750 sqft apartment) or personalize the estimate to customer's specific situation (short 8-minute distance, light load).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep covered: trip fee/truck inclusion ('Everything is included in that hourly rate. The gas and truck, the taxes and insurance...'), 2.5-hour minimum, and 15-minute prorated increments. 'No guess' framing not explicit. Fees/transparency fully present; commitment framing present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked 'Does that feel fair?' or equivalent. Rep moved directly to email and final check-in.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: No mention of On-Time Guarantee or any discount/guarantee terms.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Full delivery: 'we do have our no worries damage coverage. Which is our free evaluation coverage included in the hourly rate rides up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or, and reimburse for accidental damages.' Coverage amount, no deductible framing ('free'), and included-in-rate framing all present.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep did not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent. Moved to final generic question.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asked 'Do you have any other questions while you have me on the line?' — this is a throwaway generic question, not the substantive 'What's still concerning you?' version.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: No 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' catch-all asked.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' or any explicit close. Call ended with 'If you do [have questions], please don't hesitate to reach out...' and then goodbye. No ask for the business.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: No rate-lock or pricing commitment beyond the current quote mentioned.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Date (October 29th) and arrival time window (8:30 AM originally, negotiated to 10 AM or thereabouts) confirmed. Phone number (512-913-9442) confirmed at start. Addresses (6760 Winhaven Parkway unit 44070 → 4500 Winhaven Parkway) confirmed. Crew size (2 movers, box truck) implied from rate structure but not explicitly re-confirmed at booking. No specific notes left for crew about customer concerns (TV storage, mattress wrapping, light load). Partial confirmation.

top_strength: Rep gathered comprehensive logistics details and followed up substantively on all customer concerns about services and move parameters, showing strong listening and problem-solving on wrapping, TV storage, and timing constraints.
coaching_note: Section 1 quid pro quo and Section 7 explicit ask were both skipped entirely — rep moved into probing without the time-boxed framing and ended without closing for the business; this call feels like a confirmation call, not a sales call, and the two-promise section lacked the On-Time Guarantee.
